It was at the World Congress of Philosophy in 1936 and the meeting between Graham and Jeays took place on a beautiful sunny day in the town hall of Coventry. The room was filled with people discussing philosophical issues, and Graham addressed them on a variety of subjects. Then there was a break in proceedings and some sort of reception was held. Graham came forward and at once there was a stampede to get near him. When he said what he had to say, everyone there was suddenly quiet.
